_comment: Regression guard only — NOT an accuracy claim. This records whatever the engine outputs today for each approved_unit_count fixture, so an UNINTENDED change gets caught. A number matching this baseline says nothing about how close it is to the real scheme's approved count (see the ERROR% column scorecard.ts itself prints, and test-sites/README.md's honest accounting of it) — only that nothing changed since the last deliberate, explained update.
